label: Alvin I. Goldman, What Is Justified Belief?…: Goldman initially proposes reliable…
locator: pp. 13–15, section II, principles (6A)–(6B), closure and foundationalism discussion
interpretation: Initial stage of the paper, later qualified in section III. Conditional reliability does not make arbitrary unjustified input beliefs justified, and closure is a proposed theory clause rather than an independently proved adequacy norm.
